Lux Supply Club Introdcution- Hello and thank you for joining our affilate program! Lux Supply club was started by two automotive enthusiasts who seen a gap in the market for a trust worthy safe detailing product brand. It has been a dream of ours to make this a reality and with your help we can continue to grow!


Our Main Products

Devine Shine- This is a SI02 paint sealent with hydrophobic properties. 

• Advanced SiO2 technology provides superior paint protection.
• Creates a hydrophobic barrier that repels water and dirt.
• Enhances paint depth and clarity for a mirror-like shine. 
Wheel Reaper- A wheel cleaner that is extermely easy to use and is safe on all wheels. 
• Effectively removes stubborn brake dust and road grime
• Restores wheels to a superior clean, showroom-quality finish
• Easy-to-use formula saves time and effort 
Holy Suds- A soap that will leave you in shock with how much suds is formed along with how long it stays. 
• Powerful formula that effortlessly removes dirt and grime
• Protects your car’s finish and maintains  its shine
• Gentle on waxes and sealants, ensuring long-lasting protection 


Unique Selling points- All of our products are made here in the US along with each formula being carefully crafted to create a edge above the rest.

LUX Supply Club Affiliate Program Payment Terms

  1. Commission Rate:

    • Affiliates earn a set commission on all qualifying sales made through their unique referral link or code.

  2. Payment Schedule:

    • Payments are processed on a net-30 basis, meaning affiliates are paid 30 days after the end of the month in which the qualifying sales were made.
    • Example: Sales made in January are paid by the end of February.

  3. Eligible Sales:

    • Only completed, non-refunded, and non-disputed sales qualify for commission payouts. If an order is refunded or canceled, the commission on that sale will be deducted from the affiliate's balance.

  4. Affiliate Payment Method:

    • Payments are made via PayPal. Affiliates are responsible for providing correct and updated payment details in their account settings.
    • Any transaction fees associated with the payment method will be deducted from the payout amount.

  5. Tracking and Attribution:

    • Affiliates will receive credit for sales tracked via their unique referral link or code. The cookie window is [30 days], meaning purchases made within this timeframe will count toward the affiliate’s commission.

  6. Reporting:

    • Affiliates can monitor their performance, earnings, and sales reports through the LUX Supply Club Affiliate Dashboard, updated regularly.

  7. Terms of Service Agreement:

    • By participating in the LUX Supply Club Affiliate Program, affiliates agree to these payment terms and the program’s Terms of Service.
    • Affiliates found engaging in fraudulent activities, such as self-referrals, will be subject to termination and forfeiture of commissions.

  8. Modification of Payment Terms:

    • LUX Supply Club reserves the right to modify these payment terms at any time. Affiliates will be notified of changes via email or through the affiliate dashboard.
